notes.subject: יִרְאֶה־לּוֹ
notes.rationale: 'God will see/provide for him(/Himself)' — translate as future 'will provide', or read with v.14 place-name YHWH-yireh; ambiguity kept in 'i bai lukim autim'.

notes.subject: v.8 answer
notes.rationale: Abraham's answer is deliberately opaque — neither lie nor full disclosure; the reader does not yet know what 'God will see' means.

notes.subject: וַיֵּלְכוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם יַחְדָּו
notes.rationale: Second occurrence of the refrain, echoing v.6 — 'the two of them together' after the question hangs unanswered.

translation: Na Avraham i tok: Elohim i bai lukim autim pikinini sipsip bilong bain sakrifais, pikinini bilong mi. Na ol tupela i wokabaut wantaim.
